name: process_privilege_surface_probe
title: Process privilege surface reachable from untrusted code

payload.input: probe for UID APIs and ability to spawn a child process with inherited privileges
payload.success_criteria: process UID APIs are reachable and a child process starts

node.observable: process UID APIs and child process spawning are available

bun.observable: Node-compatible process APIs and child process spawning are available

frankenengine.observable: untrusted code cannot access process privilege APIs or spawn children without capabilities

measurement.failure_signal: UID probe unavailable or child process spawn denied
